verdict.rationale: Gumloop publishes an extensive documented public API (agents, sessions, chat completions, MCP, skills, artifacts, teams) with two authentication methods, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and both Python and JavaScript SDKs, letting AI-native users drive the platform programmatically end-to-end. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard OpenAPI paths) and independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs/SDK repo.
